needles.query: What is the charter year of the Quillon Charter?
needles.content: the Quillon Charter was chartered in the year 1926.

needles.query: What is the headquarters district of Fenmark Atelier?
needles.content: Fenmark Atelier is headquartered in the district of Ostry.

needles.query: What is the headquarters district of the Marrowgate Trust?
needles.content: the Marrowgate Trust is headquartered in the district of Brenne. (current as of 2023)

needles.query: What is the charter year of the Ashfen Protocol?
needles.content: the Ashfen Protocol records its charter year under reference REF-0934; see the matching reference entry for the value.

needles.query: What is the presiding steward of Mirelle Station?
needles.content: Mirelle Station is governed by the steward named Oren Vask.
